risk_summary: The disclosure is relatively well quantified, reporting revenue, margins, expenses, liquidity, and capital-raising history. Key risks include negative POS gross margins, reliance on continued revenue growth, a limited stated cash runway, and uncertainty regarding future financing. The text also contains standard forward-looking disclaimers and contingent agreement terms that modestly reduce transparency.
